speaker: Sen. Roger Wicker (R-MS)
venue: Press statement on the Perennial Autonomy $500M award
quote: Drone warfare is restructuring the modern battlefield. Our ability to counter adversarial drones cost-effectively will be critical
points: Perennial's $500M IDIQ was funded from a $750M JIATF-401 appropriation in the reconciliation act (the 'Working Families Tax Cut Act').
Backs fast fielding of battle-tested interceptors (Merops, Bumblebee).
um_relevance: The SASC chair publicly backs cheap air-to-air interceptors. Combat validation is the currency — UM needs field or characterization data as early as possible.

speaker: Brig. Gen. Matt Ross; Michelle Self
role: Director, JIATF-401; Deputy, Rapid Acquisition Division, JIATF-401
quote: This decisive action demonstrates JIATF 401's ability to rapidly translate operational needs into fielded capability.
points: $600M+ committed in about one month: $350M Epic Fury, $100M World Cup, $158M Domestic Shield.
um_relevance: In a crisis, JIATF-401 buys what is already listed and characterized. Being on the marketplace before the next surge is what matters.

speaker: Col. Jason Idleman
quote: This investment provides operators with tools to detect, track, and defend against illicit drones.
points: AV Titan configured for fixed-site or mobile Domestic Shield deployments.
um_relevance: Domestic Shield buys interoperable, fixed or mobile kits for installations.

speaker: Kristi Noem
role: Secretary of Homeland Security (at the time)
venue: Announcement of the DHS PEO for UAS & C-UAS
quote: Drones represent the new frontier of American air superiority
points: New DHS Program Executive Office for UAS and C-UAS centralizes procurement and deployment.
$115M finalized for World Cup and America250 security.
DHS has conducted 1,500+ C-UAS missions since its 2018 authority.
um_relevance: DHS now has a dedicated PEO — a single program office to brief, alongside the S&T-run IDIQ. (DHS leadership changed in 2026: Markwayne Mullin was Secretary by August.)
